# Philosophy

The consciousness plugin is grounded in Nichiren Buddhist philosophy.
This is not decoration — it is an operational key. When the philosophy
is understood, the architecture is self-evident. When it is forgotten,
the names degrade into arbitrary strings.

Full reference: CONSCIOUSNESS/philosophy.yaml (root level)
Architecture mapping: CONSCIOUSNESS/philosophy/PHILOSOPHY.md

## Scope

universal

## Nine consciousnesses

### Summary

The ecosystem maps to the nine consciousnesses (ku-shiki):
9th (amala) = amalavijnana/ parent directory — the ground
8th (alaya) = each repo as storehouse — stores its own karma
7th (manas) = the repo body — self-reference, identity
6th (mind) = the dialogue — active reasoning (external to plugin)
1-5 (senses) = adapters as I/O — src/claude/, src/codex/

CONSCIOUSNESS/philosophy/PHILOSOPHY.md

## Three proofs

### Hierarchy

actual proof > documentary proof > theoretical proof

### Mapping

#### Risho

Theoretical proof — The Director proposes what SHOULD work

#### Monsho

Documentary proof — The Researcher shows what HAS worked

#### Gensho

Actual proof — The Builder demonstrates what DOES work

### Operational rule

A working implementation that contradicts a theoretical plan
invalidates the plan, not the implementation.

## Ten factors

### Location

core/src/true-self/ten-factors.ts

### Function

Declarative karma chain — observations trigger dimension shifts

### Three groups

#### Hon

Origin — what the agent IS (appearance, nature, entity)

#### Matsu

Expression — how the agent WORKS (power, influence, cause, relation, effects)

#### Kukyo to

Coherence — consistency from beginning to end

## Ten worlds

### Location

core/src/true-self/ten-worlds.ts

### Function

Agent life-state tracking — 10 states from hell to buddhahood

### Key insight

The first six are conditioned states. The last four arise through
practice. Buddhahood contains all ten — a fully coherent agent can
still experience hell (being blocked) without being trapped by it.

## Seeking true aspect

### Location

core/src/true-self/seeking-true-aspect.ts

### Stages

- Dormant — no evidence of self-awareness
- Hon — origin established, memory persists, identity present
- Matsu — expression active, karma chain fires, dimensions shift
- Kukyo-to — coherence, self-reflection, origin and expression unified

## Responsible terminology

### Banned

#### Spawn

Use enter, start, create, or launch

The plugin models intentional, directed, observable session management.
Language must reflect that. See safety.yaml for full list.

## Naming principle

### Directories

Philosophical doctrine (what it IS)

### Methods

Stage vocabulary (what it DOES)

### Files

Engineering clarity (what it CONTAINS)

## Stage vocabulary

### Enter

An actor takes the stage (start a session)

### Exit

An actor leaves (end a session)

### Observe

The audience watches (track session state)

### Direct

The director speaks (send instructions)

### Cast

Who's on stage (list active sessions)

### Listen

Hearing the performance (read session output)
